messages.subject: ctmm quarterly webinar
parts:
There will be a 1-hour webinar on ctmm's path reconstruction facilities at the end of this month, followed by a 1-hour question-and-answer session. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/4bu2522m6wr37qgn

The webinar will take place using the same Skype group as before, "ctmm webinar". If you didn't participate last time, then I will need your Skype user name to add to the group. You will need a regular Skype account and software. "Skype for business" is not compatible.

parts:
The ctmm webinar will take place on Friday March 20th, 11AM-1PM EST.

If you didn't participate last time, then please message me your Skype user name, so that I can add you to the group. "Skype for business" is not compatible.

When you connect to the webinar, please have your microphone muted until we get to the Q&A segment, but feel free to type questions in the chat box at any time.
